statement: A Glue parser failing with 'An error occurred while calling oNNN.jdbc. This connection has been closed.' tells you why the write failed.
outcome: SQLSTATE 08003 is thrown only by checkClosed() on an already-dead connection. Spark 3.3.0 savePartition's finally block calls conn.rollback() unguarded (JdbcUtils.scala:748), so on a dead connection it throws and DISCARDS the primary exception - and conn.close() on the next line never runs, leaking the connection. Sibling runs where rollback succeeded report the real causes: 'server closed the connection unexpectedly', EOFException, 'I/O error occurred while sending to the backend', 'Timed-out waiting to acquire database connection'.

Making them agree left an expired hold fully sweep-eligible, and with a 5-minute sweep against a 30-minute cleanup it re-dispatched a collection that had published its failure done a week earlier.

A blocked item can be neither unblocked nor completed, only replaced, so the cost is a re-verification cycle.

statement: The 50000 row cap is a Cymulate constant inherited verbatim from AgentService with no recorded rationale, not a Cortex limit; Cortex's own default when no limit is stated is 1000000

statement: One stdout line above the 1 MiB per-line limit destroys a whole provider run: SystemProcessRunner throws InvalidDataException from the drain, the adapter turns it into ProtocolError, and every event already collected is discarded — while a line that is merely unparseable is tolerated, noted as a parse failure, and the run continues

statement: The deterministic input dimension 10 needs is evidence counted by source type, and the projection does not capture it: the corpus holds 550 source-read, 350 local-probe, 312 test-run and 112 live-run records under seventeen distinct spellings, so a task whose claims rest entirely on source reads with no test or live run demonstrated nothing empirical and the projection cannot currently say so

A scorer asking whether an outcome was proven needs the count keyed by how each record was obtained, so canonicalise the spelling at the projection and keep the raw value in the record.

statement: Completing every work item before dispatching a code reviewer closes every route to a governed review: a run cannot start on a completed item, a task-wide run is granted no ledger access so a reviewer could not file the output its run needs to close, and the Learn arm then has nothing to satisfy it but a waiver
